_comment: Configuration rules and thresholds for strike_select.py and strike_select_tab.py. Everything tunable lives here — no hardcoded numbers in logic.
_premium_band_min_note: Lower bound of recommended option buying premium band in rupees (Source rule: ₹200–₹300). Below ₹200, delta is too low to convert moves.
_premium_band_max_note: Upper bound of recommended option buying premium band in rupees. Above ₹300, trader pays for unnecessary intrinsic value and ties up capital.
_capital_max_lot_pct_note: Capital risk guardrail: Flag strikes where 1 lot cost exceeds this percentage of account capital (e.g. 30% of ₹20,000 = ₹6,000 max).
_default_target_pts_note: Default spot target in index points (Source setup: 40 points).
_default_stop_pts_note: Default spot stop loss in index points (Source setup: 40 points).

sub_10.description: Momentum is sluggish. Correct directional calls often fail to gain premium (Source live case: 20 pt spot move produced only 3 pt option gain).

normal_10_20.description: Ideal momentum regime. Greeks behave predictably and delta converts directional moves without excessive premium churn.

excessive_above_20.description: Elevated implied volatility. Rapid swings and IV crush risk make naked buying prone to whipsaws.

_vega_iv_shift_points_note: Standard IV shock in percentage points to model vega impact (±2 IV points).
_default_lot_size_note: NIFTY lot size fallback if not found in config.
_default_capital_note: Trading capital fallback in rupees if not found in config.
_min_bid_price_note: Minimum bid price in rupees to filter out dead/illiquid strikes.
_focus_strikes_count_note: Number of strikes above and below ATM to include in candidate table.
